title: DeepSeek-R1 joined the text lineup
summary:
A new reasoning model and a repaired community showcase made it easier to find both things to build with and things people have built.

The reasoning-enabled `deepseek-r1` model was added, `llamalight` moved to Llama 3.1 8B, and the text API’s 60-request per-IP queue cap was removed.

Project listings missing after the previous UI update were restored and organized by type. A new Submit Your Project button opens a GitHub issue form, while AI PowerPoint Generator, Pollinations Chat, and the Android RPG Deep Saga joined the listings. The shelf has more on it, and there’s a clearer way to add your own.

Image requests with a valid priority token can bypass the per-IP generation queue; other requests continue through the normal queue. Separately, the prompt enhancer’s model information now names Azure OpenAI correctly, with no change to how the enhancer works.

Supporter links without a protocol now open as HTTPS links instead of resolving within pollinations.ai. A lime favicon makes the site easier to pick out in a row of tabs, and the site and README received updated image-generation figures and a clearer description of the project.
